messages:
Maya Bhattacharya: Quick sync \u2014 we need to decide ownership split for the ingress proxy that fronts Hosted/Dedicated/Private and how telemetry handoff should look. TL;DR: avoid duplicate metrics and preserve tenant identity across mode switches.
Oliver Chen: +1. do we mean separate proxy binaries per hosting mode or one proxy with mode flags? :thinking: 
Samir Patel: Two options: (A) thin unified proxy that normalizes API and delegates routing to mode-specific adapters (single binary, plugins) OR (B) per-mode proxies (hosted-proxy, dedicated-proxy, private-proxy) with shared lib for common logic. Ops vs isolation tradeoffs.
Jen Li: Telemetry: how to avoid double-counting when requests pass through proxy + adapter? need to preserve trace/span context (W3C traceparent).
Maya Bhattacharya: Also data residency for Private customers  telemetry may need to stay local or be scrubbed.
Oliver Chen: Ops take: per-mode proxies let us have different routing/circuit-breakers per tier without runtime flags, but increases release surface.
Samir Patel: Unified proxy simplifies client trust boundary; adapters provide escape hatches for strict egress.
Dana Morris: Compliance: Private customers may require no identifiers leave their VPC. Telemetry schema must support redaction or in-place aggregation.
Jen Li: Proposal for canonical exit telemetry event: fields = mode, tenant_id_hash, route, latency_ms, sampled_trace (bool). No raw tenant IDs.
Samir Patel: Adapter API sketch: adapters call handoff.emit(event). The runtime decides sink based on mode. API: handoff.emit({k:v}) where adapter specifies event; adapter runtime ensures de-dup and sink selection.
Maya Bhattacharya: Example config: 
``
proxy:
  mode: hosted # hosted|dedicated|private
  telemetry:
    sink: central|local
    sample_rate: 0.05
    redaction: tenant_hash
```
Oliver Chen: Fallback question: if hosted capacity saturated and we route to dedicated, must preserve tenant_id_hash semantics.
Jen Li: Tenant hashing must be deterministic, based on stable secret per-org. For Private the secret is customer-controlled; onboarding must provide a mapping or deterministic HMAC key.
Dana Morris: Add audit event `telemetry_policy` when proxy switches sink or redaction mode for visibility.
Maya Bhattacharya: Short-term decision: unified proxy + mode adapters, implement handoff.emit API, canonical exit event, deterministic tenant hashing. Long-term: consider splitting binaries if ops overhead grows.
Oliver Chen: +1. Need feature flags and a test harness to simulate private/local sinks.
Samir Patel: I'll draft Adapter interface PR: Adapter.handoffEmit(map[string]interface{}) and include a mock localSink for e2e tests.
Jen Li: I'll draft telemetry schema doc with required redaction fields and sampling guidance.
Dana Morris: I'll specify audit event fields and retention guidance.
Infra-bot: Reminder: include canary tag `proxy-unified-canary` in deploy pipeline for canary runs.
Maya Bhattacharya: Action items: Samir (Adapter PR by end of week), Jen (telemetry schema + compliance checklist by Wed), Oliver (canary run with 1% sample on staging), Dana (confirm audit event content). If no objections I'll fold this into the hosting-abstraction RFC. :thumbsup:
Oliver Chen: No objections from infra.
Jen Li: Fine; will flag if legal raises privacy issues.
Samir Patel: Starting PR now.
Dana Morris: 👍
Maya Bhattacharya: Closing thread; will add checklist to RFC follow-up.
